what: A serif title is split by letter, and when a letter crosses the line at screen height ÷ 1.15, it turns on transparent 0→1 over .5s ease — the delay is .3s for every 2nth·.15s for every 3n+1th (.15s if both)·0 for the rest, repeating every six letters, so a line rises here and there in a staggered way like stars switching on rather than from the left. Firing fx:show lights everything at once (when the loader lifts)

options.dur: Duration of one character lighting up (sec), default .5
options.d3: Delay (s) for every 3n+1th character, default .15 — if it overlaps with 2n, this value wins
options.at: Trigger line — screen height ÷ at, default 1.15 (87% from the top of the screen)
options.fx:show: Fire this event at the element to light up all remaining characters at once

from.where: index.html .hc-hdd · .hc-subhdd · feature names — original site.js fadeText() (wraps each text chunk in a span per \S) · fadeTextInner() (t_h > when top − wh/1.15 is reached it becomes is_view) · common.css .fadeTextAnim > span { opacity 0 · all .5s ease } · :nth-child(2n) .3s · :nth-child(3n+1) .15s

note: The original uses no transform on the text, so it stays an inline span — line breaks and keep-all match the source
